notes: The only place akuko keeps model ids and prices (plan R-2). Every model carries a last_verified date; `doctor` flags entries older than stale_after_days. billing: free = costs akuko nothing; direct-api = akuko calls a paid HTTP API with the user's key (on host A only with a key pasted for that chat, lib/spend.md R-11); connected-mcp = a paid generation tool on a connected MCP server (needs the confirmation line on host A). unverified_models lists models akuko can call but cannot price: they are never runnable. network names the no-cost probe url and every domain akuko contacts (scripts/probe.ts; claude.ai's network settings). Entries with example: true are placeholders for tests and for WP-06 to replace: their prices are illustrative, not quotes, and the gate refuses them outside tests.

manual-handoff.source: No cost to akuko: you paste the prompt package into a tool of your choice. Any spend you report when handing the file back is recorded in the ledger.

network.note: The video download (files/<id>:download?alt=media) may redirect to another Google host; Google does not name it. akuko never sends the key to a redirect.

gemini-omni-1.2-flash#360p#audio.source: https://aistudio.google.com/docs/pricing, Gemini Omni 1.2 Flash, Standard paid tier, read 2026-11-12: video output "$12.00" per 1M tokens, "calculated at a rate of" 1,931 tokens per second of 360p video; 1,931 x 12 / 1,000,000 = 0.023172, rounded up to 0.0232 USD/s. akuko strips '#360p#audio' and sends resolution "360p". Request: POST https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/v1beta/interactions with x-goog-api-key; input = the start frame (type image, base64) then the prompt; response_format type video, duration "3s" to "15s" (whole seconds), resolution, aspect_ratio "16:9" or "9:16", delivery "uri"; generation_config.video_config.task image_to_video; the video comes back in steps[].content[] (type video) as a files/<id>:download uri, polled until ACTIVE (https://aistudio.google.com/docs/omni, read 2026-11-12). Sound: the model makes native audio and the docs give no switch, so every id carries '#audio'. Veo is gone from the Gemini API: veo-3.1-generate-preview, veo-3.1-fast-generate-preview and veo-3.1-lite-generate-preview were shut down on October 22, 2026, with gemini-omni-1.2-flash named as the replacement (https://aistudio.google.com/docs/deprecations, read 2026-11-12). Reference images are also billed as input tokens ($1.50 per 1M) and are not in this price.

kling-video.label: Kling video (Kling's own API) — your Kling access key and secret key

network.note: The host the finished video downloads from is not documented (Kling's own examples use p2-kling.klingai.com); if a download is blocked, the error names the host to allow.

kling-v2-5-turbo#std.source: https://kling.ai/document-api/pricing/base/video (Balance view), read 2026-11-12: Kling 2.5 Turbo, no native audio, 720P: $0.042/s ('Total duration = Output duration'). Clip lengths 5 or 10 s (https://kling.ai/document-api/guides/capability-map/video, read 2026-11-12). akuko strips the '#' suffixes and sends mode "std" and sound "off". Request (https://kling.ai/document-api/api/video/2-6/image-to-video/legacy, read 2026-11-12): POST https://api-singapore.klingai.com/v1/videos/image2video with model_name, image (raw base64, no data: prefix; jpg/png, 10 MB or less, at least 300 px, aspect 1:2.5 to 2.5:1), prompt and negative_prompt (2,500 characters each), duration (a string), mode std (720P) or pro (1080P), sound on/off; poll GET /v1/videos/image2video/<task_id> until task_status is succeed or failed; the video is data.task_result.videos[0].url (kept 30 days). Auth: an access key and secret key signed into an HS256 JWT (iss = access key, exp = now + 1800 s, nbf = now - 5 s), sent as Authorization: Bearer (https://kling.ai/document-api/api/get-started/authentication, ak-sk tab, read 2026-11-12); the same page also offers a single API key, which akuko does not use. Kling's API draws on a prepaid resource package or balance: buy one in the Kling developer console first (error 1102 means it is used up). api-singapore.klingai.com is the host for users outside China.

byteplus-video.label: BytePlus ModelArk video (Seedance, direct) — your ModelArk API key

network.note: Finished videos are served from a BytePlus storage URL whose host the docs do not name; if the download is blocked, the error names the host to allow. The probe is a GET of a task that does not exist (401 without a key), never a create call.

dreamina-seedance-2-0-fast-260128#480p.source: https://docs.byteplus.com/docs/en/modelark/model-pricing.md, read 2026-11-12: Dreamina Seedance 2.0 Fast (dreamina-seedance-2-0-fast-260128), online inference, input without video, 480p: $5.6 per 1M tokens. Largest 480p frame (https://docs.byteplus.com/docs/en/modelark/create-video-generation-task-api.md): 992x432 or 864x496 (428,544 px) = 10,044.000 tokens/s at 24 fps, x 5.6 / 1,000,000 = 0.056246, rounded up to 0.0563 USD/s. Lengths 4 to 15 s. akuko strips the '#480p' suffix, sends resolution "480p" and generate_audio false. Request (https://docs.byteplus.com/docs/en/modelark/create-video-generation-task-api.md, read 2026-11-12): POST https://ark.ap-southeast.bytepluses.com/api/v3/contents/generations/tasks with model, content [text, image_url (data:image/<fmt>;base64,...) role first_frame], resolution, ratio "adaptive", duration (whole seconds), generate_audio, watermark false; poll GET .../tasks/<id> (https://docs.byteplus.com/docs/en/modelark/get-video-generation-task-api.md, read 2026-11-12) until succeeded; the video is content.video_url (valid 24 hours). Auth: Authorization: Bearer <key> (https://docs.byteplus.com/docs/en/modelark/base-url-and-authentication.md, read 2026-11-12; the docs' examples name the variable ARK_API_KEY). Region ap-southeast-1 only; the model must be activated in the ModelArk console first (else 404 ModelNotOpen). Billing is by tokens: (input video + output seconds) x width x height x frame rate (24) / 1024. akuko prices output seconds at the largest frame BytePlus lists for that resolution (any ratio), so the real bill is the same or a little lower. The price is the same with or without generated audio (the formula has no audio term).

Request (https://docs.byteplus.com/docs/en/modelark/create-video-generation-task-api.md, read 2026-11-12): POST https://ark.ap-southeast.bytepluses.com/api/v3/contents/generations/tasks with model, content [text, image_url (data:image/<fmt>;base64,...) role first_frame], resolution, ratio "adaptive", duration (whole seconds), generate_audio, watermark false; poll GET .../tasks/<id> (https://docs.byteplus.com/docs/en/modelark/get-video-generation-task-api.md, read 2026-11-12) until succeeded; the video is content.video_url (valid 24 hours). Auth: Authorization: Bearer <key> (https://docs.byteplus.com/docs/en/modelark/base-url-and-authentication.md, read 2026-11-12; the docs' examples name the variable ARK_API_KEY). Region ap-southeast-1 only; the model must be activated in the ModelArk console first (else 404 ModelNotOpen). Billing is by tokens: (input video + output seconds) x width x height x frame rate (24) / 1024. akuko prices output seconds at the largest frame BytePlus lists for that resolution (any ratio), so the real bill is the same or a little lower. The price is the same with or without generated audio (the formula has no audio term).

seedance-1-5-pro-251215#720p.source: Named in the request examples of https://docs.byteplus.com/docs/en/modelark/create-video-generation-task-api.md (read 2026-11-12) but absent from the model list (https://docs.byteplus.com/docs/en/modelark/model-list.md) and from the pricing table (https://docs.byteplus.com/docs/en/modelark/model-pricing.md), which has no Seedance 1.5 pro row. fal-lipsync.label: fal lip-sync (still or clip + a spoken line) — your fal key

network.note: fal returns finished files on fal.media hosts (v3.fal.media in akuko's tests); fal does not list its download hosts.

minimax/h3-max/lip-sync/image-to-video.source: IMAGE + AUDIO (default for a still with a spoken line). https://fal.ai/models/minimax/h3-max/lip-sync/image-to-video/llms.txt, read 2026-11-10: "Billing is calculated per second of generated video": 480p $0.05, 768p $0.08, 1080p $0.16, 2K $0.32 per second; videos over 15 s get a 1.2x multiplier. akuko always sends resolution "768P" and refuses a segment over 15 s (so the multiplier never applies). Request (https://fal.ai/models/minimax/h3-max/lip-sync/image-to-video/api): image_url (aspect ratio 0.4-2.5), audio_url (at least 5 s, up to 15 min), resolution, enable_transcription, seed; output video.url, duration (matches the audio). The pricing page https://fal.ai/pricing does not list it; the model page does.

veed/fabric-1.0#480p.source: IMAGE + AUDIO (fallback). https://fal.ai/models/veed/fabric-1.0/llms.txt, read 2026-11-10: "480p - $0.08 per second, 720p - $0.15 per second" (fal's page does not say whether those are audio or output seconds, so akuko prices max(audio, 1 s) of the line). Request: image_url, audio_url, resolution ("720p" or "480p", required); the page states no audio length limit; output video.url. akuko strips the "#480p" suffix and sends it as resolution. It is the default for a line under 5 s (h3-max needs 5 s or more).

veed/fabric-1.0#720p.source: IMAGE + AUDIO (fallback, higher resolution). Same endpoint and page as the 480p entry (https://fal.ai/models/veed/fabric-1.0/llms.txt, read 2026-11-10): 720p $0.15 per second. akuko strips the "#720p" suffix and sends it as resolution. Same billing-basis gap as the 480p entry: fal does not say whether those are audio or output seconds; akuko prices max(audio, 1 s).

fal-ai/kling-video/lipsync/audio-to-vide.source: VIDEO + AUDIO (default for an approved clip). https://fal.ai/models/fal-ai/kling-video/lipsync/audio-to-video (and its llms.txt), read 2026-11-10: "$0.014 per input video seconds, rolling up to closest 5 second increment". fal's docs page https://fal.ai/docs/model-api-reference/video-generation-api/kling-video-lipsync, read the same day, words it as "$0.014 per 5-second increment"; the two disagree, so akuko prices the dearer reading ($0.014 per second, rounded up to 5 s) and the real bill may be lower. Request: video_url (.mp4/.mov, up to 100 MB, 2-10 s, 720p or 1080p, sides 720-1920 px), audio_url (2-60 s, up to 5 MB), enable_safety_checker; output video.url.

veed/lipsync/v2.source: VIDEO + AUDIO (fallback). https://fal.ai/models/veed/lipsync/v2/llms.txt, read 2026-11-10: "$0.07 for every second of output video". Request: video_url, audio_url (no limits stated on the page); output video.url.
